newsitem.title: USA: Fran's center within 100 miles of shore.
newsitem.headline: Fran's center within 100 miles of shore.

text.p: The center of Hurricane Fran was near latitude 32.7 north and longitude 77.9 west, or about 90 miles (145 km) south-southeast of South Carolina's border with North Carolina at 1600 EDT/2000 GMT, the National Hurricane Center said.
At 1500/1900, when the center issued its last intermediate advisory, the storm was packing winds of 115 mph (185 kmh) and travelling toward the north-northwest near 16 mph (26 kmh).
